summary: NATIVE-UX-004 is complete for the Phase 4 native preview surfaces. Import/export now has a step-wise Android UI, explicit safety copy, richer dry-run/result reports, graph snapshot export support, preset deferred state, wipe recovery affordance, and HMA-AL00 screenshot/XML plus automated verification evidence.
